messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi its Marcus from the music shop, you asked about strings for your acoustic?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yes! the ones on it hurt my fingers a lot

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: thats normal at the start. the factory ones are usually medium gauge, try lights, much easier on beginners

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: whats the difference between nickel and bronze

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: bronze is brighter and made for acoustics, nickel is mostly for electric. you want phosphor bronze lights

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok how much

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: about 70 hkd. come in saturday and ill put them on for you, takes 5 mins, no charge for that

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: thanks!! can my mum come? she wants to see where i go

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: of course, bring her. we also do trial lessons on saturdays, 30 mins, first one free, parents can sit in

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: can you send a pic of the strings so i know which pack to look for

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: perfect see you saturday

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: cool. dont practise too hard before then, your fingertips need a rest haha

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你好，我係琴行嗰個，你之前問過啲弦喎

messages.text: 係呀，啲弦好硬，隻手指好痛

messages.text: 正常啦，初學都係咁。轉 light gauge 會易好多

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 幾錢呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 七十蚊左右。星期六你嚟，我幫你換，唔使錢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀！我叫媽咪一齊嚟得唔得

messages.text: 得㗎，歡迎佢嚟。試堂都係星期六，半個鐘，第一堂免費，家長可以坐埋一齊聽

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀多謝你，到時見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好，到時見。今個星期唔好練到太夜，手指要休息下

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: Hi Marcus，我係上星期喺你哋舖頭買結他嗰個

messages.text: 記得呀！隻 acoustic 啱啱好呢，點呀，彈得慣未

messages.text: OK 嘅，不過啲弦好硬，彈完手指好痛

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就轉 light gauge 啦，11 號嗰種，初學好好多

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁 nickel 同 bronze 有咩分別呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Bronze 聲靚啲，acoustic 就用佢。Nickel 多數 electric 先用

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 原來係咁，thx

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你星期六得唔得閒？嚟舖頭我幫你換，五分鐘搞掂，唔收錢

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 得呀，我同我媽咪一齊嚟得嗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure，歡迎晒。我哋星期六仲有 trial lesson，半個鐘，第一堂 free，家長可以坐喺度

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: nice，咁我哋諗下先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 冇問題，唔使急，你想 book 就同我講

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀 thx，我 send 張單畀你睇下我買咗咩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咦你 send 錯咗喎？係你張 price list 嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哈哈 sor send 錯，呢張先係，你睇下條 string 個 code

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: hi its Jay, i got the acoustic from your shop last week

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: oh yeah i remember you! the one who tested every guitar on the wall haha

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yeah sorry about that

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: dont be, nobody takes it that seriously. how are the strings treating you

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: so hard. my fingers are all sore

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: light gauge strings will fix that. i can sort you a set

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: how much are they

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: normally 70. for you 50. i only do that for kids i like though, so dont mention it to other customers ok

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: oh. ok i guess

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: or just say its the normal price if anyone asks, up to you. no big deal

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i think ill just tell my mum its the usual price and ask her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure sure, whatever works. 70 is totally fine too

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. can i come saturday around 3

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 3 works. ill have the strings on the counter

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: is the trial lesson still free

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: yep first one is free, 30 mins. bring whoever you like

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok cool, my mum will probably come

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: great, see you both then

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 你好，我係上個禮拜喺你哋舖頭買結他嗰個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 記得呀，嗰個試曬牆上面所有結他嘅，哈哈

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 唔好意思呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔緊要啦。啲弦點呀，手指痛唔痛

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好痛，仲起咗啲皮

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 轉 light gauge 就好啲。我幫你執一套，平時七十，你五十蚊，不過我淨係畀啲我鍾意嘅學生姐，你唔好同其他客講喎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哦…我同媽咪講聲先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，你自己決定，七十都 OK 嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好，星期六三點得唔得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 得，我留低套弦喺櫃檯

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喂 Kit，隻結他彈得點呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: OK 嘅，不過我 F chord 次次都按唔實

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: F chord 係好多人嘅死穴，你可以先用 mini F 練住

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咩係 mini F

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 即係淨係按頭四條線，我 send 個圖畀你

messages.text: [photo]

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哦！睇落易好多，thx

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔使客氣。你係我最近教過最有天份嗰個，真係

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 哈哈 唔係啦，我都係隨便玩

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 真㗎。啲弦硬唔硬呀，我可以幫你 set 套 light gauge，平時 70，你 50 蚊

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁好？點解咁平

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我淨係畀熟客呢個價，你唔好 post 出 IG story 住，哈哈

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我唔會 post

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你想收 70 咪照收囉，我冇所謂㗎

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我問下老母先，星期六 sure 就嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好呀，到時見

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so about the free lesson pack, strings, picks, 3 lessons. its yours if you come wednesday after we close

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: after closing? my mum wants to come with me tho

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: the pack is only for students i teach privately, if your mum comes it counts as a normal booking and i cant give it

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i dont know, i think i should ask her

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i already set aside the strings for you. kinda a waste if you dont come

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i can just buy them saturday

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: after all the tips i gave you for free, i thought you liked the lessons

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i do. ill think about it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 個免費套餐我留咗畀你，有弦有 picks 仲有三堂，你星期三收咗舖之後嚟攞啦

messages.speaker: child

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 個套餐淨係畀我私人教嘅學生，你阿媽跟埋嚟就算普通 booking，我就畀唔到

messages.text: 咁我問返阿媽先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔使問得咁細心啦，你都十四歲喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係佢會擔心㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我前排幫你免費換弦、教你嘢，原來你都唔係咁重視

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我冇唔重視呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就嚟啦，一個人嚟，我當你有誠意

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我真係唔知得唔得，我星期六先去舖頭買

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 套餐我淨係留到星期三，你自己諗清楚

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯。我睇下

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我都幾期待見到你㗎，唔好令我失望呀

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok 我再同你講

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你份 free package 我留咗喇，弦同 picks 都有，仲有三堂 lesson

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: Wow 真㗎？咁幾時去攞

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期三收舖之後，你自己嚟就得，咁就唔使排隊啦

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 但係我想叫我媽咪一齊嚟

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 佢嚟嘅話個 package 就唔 count 喇，老細會問

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 咁…我問過佢先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 點解要問呀，幫你拎嘢之前，我已經同你講過好多 tips，你知嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我知，thx

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁聽日 confirm 啦，我唔想嘥咗呢個機會

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好啦，你再諗諗，不過我都幾失望

messages.text: you went quiet after wednesday. what happened

messages.text: i told my mum i dont want the private lessons anymore

messages.text: thats not your call after what ive given you. i still have the voice note you sent me about your dad

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: you said you deleted that

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i said a lot of things. come in thursday alone or your mum gets to hear it, and ill tell my boss you took the pick set

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i didnt take anything

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: who is he going to believe. thursday, 7pm

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你頭先係咪同阿媽講咗唔上堂

messages.text: 係呀，我唔想再嚟

messages.text: 我仲留住你之前 send 畀我嗰段語音，講你同阿爸嗰啲嘢

messages.text: 你話你 del 咗㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 星期四七點一個人嚟，唔係我就播畀你阿媽聽，仲同老闆講你偷咗盒 picks

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我冇偷

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你覺得老闆信你定信我

messages.text: Marcus 我想問下，上次你話幫我留嗰套 strings 仲喺度嗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 喺呀，你終於記得我喇

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: sry 我段時間好多 test

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Test 好緊要，不過你話過你會嚟 lesson 嘅

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我同媽咪講咗，佢想我留喺屋企練多啲先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就即係你唔嚟囉？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 嗯，sry 呀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你知唔知我幫你省咗幾多錢？免費換弦、免費 lesson、仲有你上次 send 畀我嗰段 voice note

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 點解突然提呢個

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 因為我留咗段 voice note，你阿媽聽到你講嘅嘢應該會好 interested

messages.text: 你話過你 del 咗㗎喎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我可以幫你同老闆講你上次攞咗盒 picks 冇俾錢，佢好鍾意查呢啲

messages.text: 我都唔想，不過你逼我嘅

messages.text: 星期四七點，你自己嚟。我只係同你講一次

messages.text: 你想諗到幾時？我放工之前要答案

messages.text: hey its Jay, did the new strings come in?

messages.text: they did! light gauge, exactly what you wanted

messages.text: nice. can i get them saturday?

messages.text: yeah no problem. oh and the trial lesson slot, saturday is full, so the only time left is wednesday evening after we close

messages.text: oh ok

messages.text: if thats awkward we can wait for next week, up to you and your mum

messages.text: 好呀

messages.text: 得，不過試堂星期六已經 full，淨返星期三收舖之後嗰節
